author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Retroid's first dual-screen handheld has arrived, here are some (lengthy) first impressions.

Retroid Pocket Duo Lite: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RPDuo-Lite
use code "DUOLITE" for $14 off during pre-order phase (ends 9/30)
Retroid Pocket Duo Lite Plus: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RPDuo-Lite
use code "LITEPLUS" for $20 off during pre-order phase (ends 10/31)
Retroid Pocket Duo: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-RPDuo
use code "DUO" for $20 off during pre-order phase (ends 10/15)
shipping starts mid-October

Qualcomm v615.50 Vulkan drivers: https://github.com/K11MCH1/AdrenoToolsDrivers/releases/tag/v615.50

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
